detaileddescription.para: P2-01: Basic merge with all shards successful Verifies degradation flags remain false when no failures occur.
P2-02: Merge underflow detection (insufficient candidates) Verifies merge_underflow flag when result count < k.
P2-03: High overlap variance detection Verifies detection when same document appears in most shards.
P2-04: Shard failure with failed_shard_reasons tracking Verifies failed_shard_reasons populated for operator diagnostics.
P2-05: K-limit edge case - exact k candidates Verifies no underflow when exactly k documents available.
P2-06: Partial result detection across degradation flags Verifies proper coordination of partial_result with failed shard reasons.
P2-07: Bounded resource enforcement - large result set cap Verifies k-limit enforcement with large shard result sets.
P2-08: Deterministic stress - concurrent shard failures Verifies stable behavior under multiple concurrent shard failures.
P2H-01: SearchStats structure contains degradation flags Verifies that SearchStats has all Phase 2 fields.
P2H-02: Error code constants from search_error_codes.h Verifies that common error codes are defined and accessible.
P2H-03: Primary error code tracking Verifies that primary_error_code field can hold meaningful error codes.
P2H-04: Degradation flag scenarios Verifies distinct degradation flag combinations.
